title: Hormone Immunolabeling in Resin-Embedded Arabidopsis Tissues
author: Herrera-Ubaldo, Nájera-González, et al.
materials: Secondary antibodies can be conjugated to a reporter such as a fluorescent molecule. The secondary antibody binds to the primary antibody, which is generated in a different species; for example, a goat generated anti-rabbit secondary antibody that will bind to a primary antibody produced in rabbit.8.Remove the washing 1× MTSB solution.9.Blocking: add 1 mL of 1× MTSB + 1% BSA, incubate for 5 min. Repeat 3 times.10.Add 500 μL of the secondary antibody solution previously prepared in blocking buffer (1:200 to 1:2000 dilution; depending on the antibody concentration; see Note).11.Incubate for 1–2 h at 22°C–25°C, place the lid on the plate, in the dark.12.Wash 3 times with 1 mL 1× MTSB after completing, 5 min each.13.Proceed to sample mounting and observation (see sample mounting and observation section, Step 29).Note: Secondary antibody concentrations vary. A guideline is to follow the manufacturer’s recommendation. In our hands, we use a 1:1000 dilution for the Dylight 488 antibody (Abcam). The stock is 0.5 μg/μL; a 1:1000 dilution means 0.5 μg/mL.

When the secondary antibody is conjugated with alkaline phosphatase (AP), the substrate NBT-BCIP solution is used, and the enzyme reaction will produce a purple signal (Figure 3).24.After Step 23, remove the 1× TBS solution.25.Wash 3 times with blocking solution (1× TBS + 1% BSA), 5 min each.a.Mix Nitro blue tetrazolium chloride (NBT) and 5-bromo-4-chloro-4-indolyl phosphate (BCIP), check the manufacturer’s recommendation. See note below.b.Prepare the substrate solution: detection solution + NBT-BCIP solution.c.Mix Nitro blue Tetrazolium Chloride (NBT) and 5-Bromo-4-chloro-4-indolyl phosphate (BCIP), check the manufacturer’s recommendation. See note below.d.Add 1 mL solution to each well and incubate for 3–5 h in the darkness at 22°C–25°C.26.Stop the reaction by adding 1 mL TE solution to each well, leave for 10 min.27.Wash 3 times with Milli-Q water, 5 min each.28.Proceed to sample mounting and observation (see sample mounting and observation section, Step 31).Note: Stock solution NBT-BCIP contains 18.8 mg/mL NBT and 9.4 mg/mL BCIP (Merck). The final concentration needed for the reaction is 0.15 mg/mL NBT and 0.075 mg/mL BCIP.8 When using the approach as the example in Figure 2, if 4 wells are used for one experiment, this means that mix 8 mL detection buffer + 64 μL of NBT-BCIP stock solution and then use 1 mL of this mixture per well.

steps.title: Trim resin block to expose sample
steps.instruction: After polymerization, trim the resin‑embedded block to remove excess resin and orient the sample for microtomy, keeping a square shape of about 3 × 3 mm to 5 × 5 mm.

substeps.instruction: Use a blade or scalpel to cut away resin without tissue, preserving a square outline.

steps.title: Section block to obtain tissue slices
steps.instruction: Adjust the microtome (knife angle, sample position, thickness), cut sections of 10–16 µm, discard initial resin‑only sections, and collect sections that contain tissue.

substeps.instruction: Grab each section with tweezers, dip briefly in a well of distilled water to remove debris.
Transfer 5–10 sections into one well of a 24‑well plate containing 1 mL Milli‑Q water (per well).

steps.title: Block sections to prevent nonspecific binding
steps.instruction: Remove water from each well, add blocking solution (volume depends on number of sections; typically 1 mL for up to 10 sections), and wash three times for 10 min each with the same blocking solution.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation (MTSB buffer)
steps.instruction: Remove the blocking solution, add 500 µL of primary antibody solution (prepared in blocking solution + 0.025 % Tween 20, diluted 1:20–1:1000; example 1:500 for hormone antibodies), do not agitate, include control wells (no primary antibody or epitope competition), incubate 14–17 h at 4 °C in the dark, then wash twice with 1 mL 1× MTSB for 5 min each.

substeps.instruction: Prepare primary antibody: mix stock (e.g., cytokinin 4.3 µg/µL or auxin 3.12 µg/µL) to the desired dilution in blocking solution with 0.025 % Tween 20.
Add 500 µL to each well.
Incubate 14–17 h at 4 °C, lid on, protected from light.
Wash 2 ×  with 1 mL 1× MTSB, 5 min each.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation (PBS buffer)
steps.instruction: Remove the blocking solution, add 500 µL of primary antibody prepared in 1× PBS + 1 % BSA with 0.025 % Tween 20 (same dilution range), incubate 14–17 h at 4 °C, then wash twice with 1 mL 1× PBS for 5 min each.

substeps.instruction: Prepare primary antibody as above but using 1× PBS + 1 % BSA as the buffer.
Add 500 µL to each well.
Incubate 14–17 h at 4 °C, lid on, protected from light.
Wash 2 ×  with 1 mL 1× PBS, 5 min each.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation (fluorescent, MTSB)
steps.instruction: Remove the primary‑antibody wash, block three times with 1 mL 1× MTSB + 1 % BSA for 5 min each, add 500 µL secondary antibody solution (prepared in 1× MTSB + 1 % BSA, diluted 1:200–1:2000; example 1:1000 for DyLight 488, stock 0.5 µg/µL), incubate 1–2 h at 22–25 °C in the dark, then wash three times with 1 mL 1× MTSB for 5 min each.

substeps.instruction: Prepare secondary antibody: mix stock with 1× MTSB + 1 % BSA to the desired dilution.
Add 500 µL to each well.
Incubate 1–2 h at 22–25 °C, lid on, protected from light.
Wash 3 ×  with 1 mL 1× MTSB, 5 min each.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation (AP, TBS)
steps.instruction: Remove the primary‑antibody wash, block three times with 1 mL 1× TBS + 1 % BSA for 5 min each, add 500 µL secondary antibody solution (prepared in 1× TBS + 1 % BSA, diluted 1:2000; stock 1.6 mg/mL gives 0.8 µg/mL), incubate 3–5 h at 22–25 °C in the dark, then wash three times with 1 mL 1× TBS for 5 min each.

substeps.instruction: Prepare secondary antibody: mix 1 µL of 1.6 mg/mL stock with 2 mL 1× TBS + 1 % BSA (for 4 wells), yielding a 1:2000 dilution.
Add 500 µL to each well.
Incubate 3–5 h at 22–25 °C, lid on, protected from light.
Wash 3 ×  with 1 mL 1× TBS, 5 min each.

steps.title: Alkaline phosphatase staining (NBT‑BCIP)
steps.instruction: After the AP secondary incubation, remove TBS, wash three times with blocking solution (1× TBS + 1 % BSA) for 5 min each, prepare substrate by mixing detection buffer with NBT‑BCIP stock (stock: 18.8 mg/mL NBT, 9.4 mg/mL BCIP; final needed 0.15 mg/mL NBT and 0.075 mg/mL BCIP), for four wells mix 8 mL detection buffer + 64 µL NBT‑BCIP stock and add 1 mL per well, incubate 3–5 h at 22–25 °C in darkness, stop the reaction with 1 mL TE solution for 10 min, wash three times with Milli‑Q water for 5 min each, then proceed to mounting and observation.

substeps.instruction: Wash 3 ×  with 1× TBS + 1 % BSA, 5 min each.
Prepare substrate: for 4 wells combine 8 mL detection buffer with 64 µL NBT‑BCIP stock; this yields the required final concentrations.
Add 1 mL substrate to each well and incubate 3–5 h at 22–25 °C in the dark.
Stop reaction by adding 1 mL TE solution, let stand 10 min.
Wash 3 ×  with Milli‑Q water, 5 min each.
Proceed to sample mounting and microscopy.
